description: Na₂Mn(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.70 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.27 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-58°. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Mn and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom.
